target.title: docs: refresh contributing maintainer roster
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where `CONTRIBUTING.md` listed stale maintainer names and ownership areas that no longer matched the current OpenClaw people page.

## Why This Change Was Made

This replaces the duplicated maintainer roster with a pointer to the live OpenClaw people page and removes routing language that depended on the deleted area list. The change keeps contributor routing focused on issue forms, labels, and CODEOWNERS.

## User Impact

Contributors now see the current maintainer source of truth instead of outdated individual maintainer entries. Review routing guidance remains concise and avoids stale ownership claims.

## Evidence

- Verified the live people page at https://www.openclaw.org/people during the docs review.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main`
  - Result: `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`
